messages.subject: Caspian v Harburn — strategy before issue
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Before we issue: (1) instruct Harriet Stanford to settle the Particulars and advise on merits/quantum; (2) revisit the avoided-cost percentage — I think 13% is too high and exposes us on cross-examination; (3) make sure the clause 9.4 cap analysis is watertight. Let's aim to issue late Feb.

Sarah

messages.subject: RE: Caspian v Harburn — strategy before issue
messages.plaintextBody:
On the avoided-cost point — Maya's management accounts support ~11%, not 13%. I'll get the revised Schedule of Loss done so the pleaded figure ties to it. Cap looks fine: fees in the 12 months before breach were ~£609k, so cap ~£913.5k, well above our damages.

Elena
